# Morton's Seafood Restaurant & Bar

> Madisonville seafood restaurant on the Tchefuncte River.

Website: https://www.mortonsseafood.com
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Mortons-Seafood-Restaurant-130113270333909/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/mortonsseafood/
Primary keyword: Madisonville seafood restaurant

## NAP

- Name: Morton's Seafood Restaurant & Bar
- Address: 702 Water St, Madisonville, LA 70447
- Phone: (985) 845-4970
- Landmark: Tchefuncte River near the Highway 22 / Mulberry Street bridge

## Hours (shop contact page)

- Thursday–Monday: 11:00 AM–9:00 PM
- Tuesday–Wednesday: Closed

## Owner

Dawn Davis. Morton Davis opened in 1985. Dawn partnered in 1991, purchased in 2000. Louisiana Restaurant Association president, 2006.

## Board

Boiled seafood, raw and chargrilled oysters, seafood boats, po-boys, catch of the day, signature cocktails. Cypress Room holds up to 70. Boats pull up in front.

This page does not invent a Google star aggregate. Named reviews stay attributed.
